beliefs: Lowercase vowels are shifted forward by 2 (a→c, e→g, i→k, o→q, u→w) [E2]
Lowercase consonants are shifted forward by 1 (b→c, c→d, d→e) [E2, E3]
Uppercase letters are shifted forward by 2 (HELLO→JELLO, ZZZ→BZZ) [E1, E3]
Digits, punctuation, and spaces are left unchanged [E1]
Only the first character of a string is transformed; the rest is copied unchanged (abc→cbc, bbb→dbb, xyz→zyz, AbCd→CbCd, Hello World→Jello World) [E3]
The first-character rule applies regardless of case: first char shifted, remaining chars verbatim [E3]
notes: E3 shows only the first character is transformed (abc→cbc not cde; bbb→dbb; xyz→zyz; AbCd→CbCd; Hello World→Jello World). Vowels shift +2, consonants +1, uppercase +2. Rewrote predict to transform only the first character.
